item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 01/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Maliksi will move into inland Guangdong today. Under the influence of the associated broad areas of rain, it will be windy with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary. With Maliksi dissipating inland, showers will ease off slightly over the region early next week. A strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong gradually early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 01/06 (Saturday)
Wind: South to southwest force 5 to 6, occasionally force 8 on high ground. Force 4 to 5 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and a few thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
